text:
chris_support: Heads up — customer (org=acme-payments) seeing intermittent 429s hitting /v1/generate across multiple hosts. Spike started ~2026-03-09 12:15 UTC. Sample x-request-id values: req_89a2, req_b3f1, req_c4d5. Ticket INC-4321 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4321

sam_support: thanks. Can you attach a minimal curl repro + HAR + a list of request ids and timestamps? Also we need masked api key and org id. :thumbsup:

chris_support: attaching quick curl I ran locally (customer provided similar):
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hello"}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Response headers (from one failed request):
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-request-id: req_89a2
x-rw-rate-limit: 60
x-rw-remaining: 0
x-rw-reset: 16795
content-type: application/json
```
Body: `{ "error": "rate limit exceeded" }`

maria_sre: please collect the following from the customer and upload to the ticket:
- HAR from browser (if browser flow) or curl -D - to capture headers
- Full list of x-request-id + client timestamp for each 429 (CSV is fine)
- Which region (us-west/us-east/eu) and model variant they were hitting
- Any proxy/load-balancer in front of them (CDN, api gateway)

kevin_ml: also ask them to include the model field and whether they were using streaming. If streaming turned on we sometimes see different throttle windows because of chunked token accounting.

sam_support: quick command we recommend for header capture:
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"replicate"}' \n  -o /dev/null -w "HTTP:%{http_code} REQUEST:%{redirect_url} SIZE:%{size_download} \n" -D headers.txt
```
That writes response headers to headers.txt which preserves x-request-id and rate headers.

ops_bot: [alert] rate_limit.spike detected: service=api-gateway region=us-west env=prod window=60s peak=340rps threshold=250rps

maria_sre: can SRE check gateway logs for the times around 2026-03-09T12:15:00Z -> +5m? I want to correlate ingress vs backend errors and check if fallback routing triggered. If you see 502s or 503s near the same time, include those logs.

chris_support: I'm collecting HAR + sample curl output + CSV of ids/times. Uploaded a small debug bundle to INC-4321 attachments: har_acme_03109.har, headers_sample.txt, ids_03109.csv. Note: customer reports spike from 12:14:40 -> 12:17:05 UTC and then normalizing.

kevin_ml: one more ask — include the request body sizes if possible. Large payloads can push into different batching paths which may hit different quota accounting.

sam_support: perfect — once SRE confirms ingress traces, we'll analyze windowing and decide whether to adjust burst policy or identify a client misconfiguration. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:

chris_support: pinging here when SRE has traces so I can update customer. I also redacted the API key in uploaded logs.
